releases.name: Apidya' Special
releases.summary:
The legendary 1992 Amiga shoot ’em up Apidya is making its long-awaited comeback. 

Developed by the original team, together with a devoted Apidya super-fan-turned-developer, Apidya’ Special is based on a previously abandoned 1990s console port, combining original assets with all-new pixel art, additional authentic sound effects, and remixed music. Legendary composer Chris Hülsbeck contributes an exclusive, completely rearranged soundtrack which has never been released.

Players can experience Apidya’ Special in true widescreen with new parallax effects or switch to the original Amiga 4:3 mode that looks, plays, and sounds exactly like 1992. Optional CRT effects with simulated shadow mask, scan lines, and phosphor bloom recreate the classic display feel.

releases.name: Monster Academy: An Interactive Story
releases.summary:
A heartwarming visual novel for kids with a rich story and engaging gameplay.

Get ready for a heartwarming visual novel for kids that offers a rich reading and gaming experience. Join Bea, a small wickling with a dim flame, and her band of unexpected outcasts including a shy gargoyle, a loud bat, and a chaotic gremlin as they get ready for the legendary Grand Howl.

• Extensive Story: Featuring over 10,000 words distributed across multiple engaging chapters.

• Format: An immersive visual novel designed specifically for kids.

• Educational Values: Transmits powerful educational values about friendship, self-acceptance, and empathy, showing that true strength comes from being a gentle light that helps others stop hiding rather than trying to blind the world.

releases.name: Outbreak Compound
releases.summary: Outbreak Compound is a fast-paced top-down zombie survival shooter where every second counts. Trapped inside a devastated compound overrun by the undead, you must fight through relentless waves of infected, scavenge powerful weapons, and use explosives wisely to stay alive. From tight defensive holds to chaotic last stands, survival depends on quick reflexes, smart positioning, and ruthless firepower.

releases.name: Colorbound
releases.summary: In Colorbound, color is more than just hue. As Anku, an Aymara boy with a unique gift, you’ll harness the power of color to shape the environment itself, uncovering hidden paths to navigate challenging and complex puzzles.

releases.name: House Cleaner Simulator
releases.summary: Build your own cleaning empire! Unlock tools, take on bigger jobs, and clean your way to fame and fortune in this unique cleaning simulator.

releases.name: Mireglow
releases.summary: Step into a peaceful mystical swamp filled with wonder and hidden discoveries.

releases.name: Blocky Powers
releases.summary:
BLOCKY POWERS is a block-stacking game that combines realistic physics with 2-player local multiplayer. Build the tallest and most stable tower with your friends and enjoy an exciting competition! 

You can't win just by stacking blocks. Every block is affected by weight and balance and will sway. Furthermore, strong winds will hit your tower, and even a small mistake will lead to collapse.

releases.name: Ducks in Disguise
releases.summary: Ducks in Disguise is a cozy hand-drawn hidden object game where you find hundreds of hidden rubber ducks in intricate 2D illustrations and collect them in your personal scrapbook.

releases.name: Horror Prison: Escape
releases.summary: You're not alone.

releases.name: Increbraintal
releases.summary: Protect your brain from viruses in Increbraintal, an incremental auto battler. Build your team and unlock upgrades in the Skill Tree to eliminate the contamination taking over the body.

releases.name: Emergency Rush (Gametry)
releases.summary:
Drive fast, dodge traffic, and save lives in Emergency Rush!

Take control of an ambulance and race through dangerous highways filled with cars, trucks, buses, and obstacles. Use nitro boosts, react quickly, and survive intense traffic as you drive across desert, forest, and snowy roads.
Every run is a test of speed, timing, and reflexes. Avoid crashes, keep moving, and reach the emergency before it is too late.

Emergency Rush is a fast, simple, and exciting ambulance driving game for players who love highway action, racing, and quick reflex challenges.

releases.name: Feed Them
releases.summary:
They need to eat

Dig your way through a world of underground puzzles in this fun and addictive adventure.

Use your shovel to carve paths through dirt and sand, guiding streams of balls toward hungry underground creatures. Each stage challenges you to think ahead, plan your routes carefully, and make the most of every ball as you work your way deeper underground.

Across 50 handcrafted levels spread over 5 unique worlds, you'll encounter a variety of enemies including carnivorous plants, dragons, giant worms, salamanders, and bats. Every stage contains three smaller enemies that must be defeated to earn stars. Feed them enough balls and they'll release a star. Collect all three stars, then take on the larger boss waiting at the bottom of the level to complete the stage.

But digging a simple path won't be enough. As you progress, new obstacles and mechanics are introduced that transform each level into a clever puzzle. Navigate around lava pits, dodge deadly lasers, avoid spinning blockers, slip past rotating laser traps, time your movements around pulsing laser beams, and work around immovable rocks. Discover special gates that multiply your balls and use them strategically to ensure you have enough resources to defeat every enemy and boss.

The early stages are easy to learn, but the challenge steadily grows as new obstacles combine in increasingly complex ways. Success requires careful planning, smart path creation, and creative problem solving.

Can you dig the perfect path and defeat every underground threat?

releases.name: Mega City Force
releases.summary: The crime is out of control, the streets are not clean. There are criminals and psychopaths everywhere, ready to cut anyone's throat. A corrupt megacorporation squeezes the life out of the citizens, seeking to establish control all over the city. Only the incorruptible police officers of Mega City Police Department stand fast before the crime wave that consumed the city and threatens to overwhelm society. Choose your cop and dive into a deadly battle against the criminals and brutal bosses to unleash the beast of justice in the darkest corners of the city.

releases.name: Hearthwater
releases.summary:
Escape to a peaceful seaside village and discover every hidden corner.

Welcome to Hearthwater, a cozy exploration game where there's no combat, no timers, and no pressure—just a beautiful village waiting to be explored. Wander along sandy beaches, stroll through quiet streets, and venture into forests, hills, and hidden paths as you uncover every location the village has to offer.

Take your time soaking in the relaxing atmosphere while searching for landmarks, secret spots, and scenic viewpoints. Every path leads to something new, encouraging you to explore at your own pace and experience the charm of Hearthwater.

Features
> Explore a peaceful seaside village.
> Discover every unique location and hidden area.
> Relax with a cozy, stress-free exploration experience.
> Immerse yourself in a calm atmosphere.
> Take your time—there are no timers, combat, or pressure.

Every path has a story. Every corner is waiting to be discovered.

releases.name: With Eyes of Ice
releases.summary:
Dying of frostbite in the cold, unforgiving environs of Iceland, Greta Egilsdottir is left to wonder how, exactly, she found herself in such a dire situation.

Perhaps it began with Steina's baby, or with Kai agreeing to stay the night, or with that kiss she almost shared with Nataniel. Perhaps it began when she journeyed from her home of Reykjahlio to work as a housemaid in the distant fishing village of Myrakot...

Or perhaps it began three years ago, when her grandmother was still alive, and she lived in the small farming village of Reykjahlio.

That was when Gréeta first met him: the world-weary doctor with the fair hair, the tired eyes, and the intense, almost obsessive desire to help people.

For Greta, meeting Nataniel Johannsson was love at first sight... But there are some loves which cannot - or perhaps should not - be.

releases.name: Suncroft
releases.summary:
Welcome to Suncroft, a cozy exploration game where every street and hidden corner invites you to slow down and enjoy the journey!

Take your time strolling through the town, discovering hidden paths, relaxing by fountains, and uncovering charming landmarks scattered throughout the world. With no combat, no timers, and no pressure, Suncroft is all about exploring at your own pace and soaking in its warm, welcoming atmosphere.

Features
>Explore a handcrafted sunny town.
>Discover every unique location and hidden area.
>Enjoy a relaxing, stress-free exploration experience.
>Immerse yourself in a warm and peaceful atmosphere.
>No combat, no timers, and no pressure—just exploration

releases.name: Kero Kero Cowboy
releases.summary:
Kero Kero Cowboy is a cartoony western themed retro style platformer!

Explore the frontier as Kero Kero, a cowboy frog on a quest to bring peace and justice to the Wild West. Use your extendable tongue, trusty six-shooter, and wits to conquer the wildest outlaws of the west. Yeehaw!

Face dastardly foes, perilous platforming challenges, and intense shootouts across deserts, mines, mountains, trains, forests, and beyond!

Kero Kero features an array of techniques and abilities to help him on his quest. He can eat enemies, spit them back out, or even brandish a giant revolver to dispatch far-off foes! But be aware, a 6-shooter only has room for 6 bullets, so use them wisely! He can also swim with ease, ride in a giant cowboy boot to stomp enemies, ride rails in a mine cart, and spit hot fire after eating a spicy jalapeño pepper. How to best utilize his abilities in each scenario is up to you, the player!

releases.name: The Witch's Bakery
releases.summary:
The Witch's Bakery is a cozy Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris. She has one special power: she can see into people's heart and heal emotions through magic!

The story progresses through the days as you earn experience, money, and fame, meet new friends and heal their heart.

For some people, their emotion is locked away so strongly than Lunne needs to go inside their heart to help them. She enters their "Heart Palace", a magical space where emotions and thoughts take shape. Lunne needs to guide the personified Emotion back to the heart.

Inside the Heart Palace, Lunne discovers the person's deepest struggles and finds the key ingredient she needs to make a bread that will heal them!

releases.name: OVER REQUIEMZ
releases.summary:
You have wandered into Oz, a faraway kingdom ruled by four witches and the king, after being caught up in a terrifying tornado. 

But you are not welcome. Sentenced to death upon arrival, you are ordered to investigate mysterious ruins along with four murderers on death row and a secretive supervisor of the condemned. 

Your only choice is to escape the death sentence and discover a way home.

releases.name: Grim Trials
releases.summary: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials. Explore the (after)life of the Academy – a training ground for aspiring Grim Reapers. Befriend fellow Reapers, learn from your mentors, and uncover the secrets of your life and love before your death.

releases.name: Beach Volleyball Girls: Hot Spike
releases.summary:
The summer roster has one spot left, and every player on the sand wants it just as bad as you do. Off the court, the real competition starts.

One reads every move you make and expects the same back. One only warms up once you've earned it. Another flirts hard until the score gets close, then turns cold and competitive without warning. And the captain trusts no one who hasn't proven they belong.

Say the right thing and the tension breaks. Say the wrong thing and you're benched.

Thirty days until the season opener, and every day you waste, someone else closes the gap.

releases.name: WordHive 2
releases.summary:
Build words, score points, and master the hive.

Word Hive 2 is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you seven letters: six outer letters and one required center letter. Use them to create as many words as possible. Every word must include the center letter.

Letters may be used more than once, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all seven letters, known as pangrams, award bonus points.

Put your mind to the test with every puzzle, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience.

Increase your score to climb the ranks, uncover every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master.

Word Hive 2 uses an American English dictionary.

Features
• Play through 2,000 all-new word puzzle levels
• Discover special words called pangrams by using all seven letters
• Learn new English words and expand your vocabulary as you play
• Compete with players around the world on the online leaderboard
• Resume your last game and continue where you left off
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode

releases.name: Zed and Zee
releases.summary:
In the far-off future of 20XX, the brilliant roboticist Dr. Otto Matton builds the two most advanced humanoid robots ever created: Zed and Zee.  But when they learn that their purpose is to lead Matton's army of super bots to world domination, they rebel against their creator and his sinister ambitions.  Now it's up to them to put a stop to Dr. Matton's schemes and prevent the world from falling into his hands!

Run, jump, and stomp through six colorful worlds of fast-paced, arcade-style action!  Passwords allow you to pick up where you left off last time!  Play solo or cooperatively with a friend, or settle your differences in the two-player Battle Mode!

releases.name: Threshold Warden
releases.summary: Upgrade your tower, place turrets and traps, defeat zombies, and collect souls to strengthen your weapons and defenses. Protect the crystal and the border of worlds at all costs!
